summary: Iteration 3 testing of GEW ERP Proforma Invoice (PI) export module. Backend: 61/61 pytest pass — 39 regression (auth/products/orders/invoices/uploads/PDFs/multi-currency from iter 1+2) + 22 NEW PI tests (auth, CRUD, auto-numbering PI-YY-NNNNN, explicit pi_number preservation, server-computed totals (qty/net-weight/amount), search across pi_number/buyer/status/buyer_country, GET 404, PUT recompute + persistence, admin-only DELETE (employee gets 403), PDF endpoint with Content-Type=application/pdf and %PDF- magic bytes, _id never leaked). Deep PDF content extraction with pypdf confirmed: company header, PI No (PI-26-NNNNN auto-numbered), buyer name, port of discharge, Incoterms, currency-aware line totals & TOTAL row using € symbol for EUR, amount-in-words 'One Thousand Euros Only', terms block, dual signature footer — all matching the FECOCIVIL S.A. export-PI specification. Frontend smoke (admin login → /proforma-invoices): sidebar item 'Proforma Invoices' present, page mounts, New Proforma modal opens with all 5 sections, Currency dropdown = USD/EUR/GBP/AED/INR, Incoterms dropdown = FOB/CIF/CFR/EXW/CIP/DAP/DDP, Status dropdown = DRAFT/SENT/ACCEPTED/CONVERTED/CANCELLED. Filling line item (1x40 ft hc, qty=6000, weight=9.1, unit=9.05) auto-updated running line totals (54,300 / 54,600 kg) and footer totals; Save POSTed and the new row PI-26-00001 with FECOCIVIL S.A. / $60,975 appeared. Download-PDF button (data-testid='pi-pdf-{id}') triggered a real blob download with suggested filename 'PI-26-00012.pdf'. No console errors, no _id leak, no broken UI. Both backend regression and the new PI module are production-ready.

issues: Empty cells render only an em-dash next to the icon — fine, but consider hiding the icon when value is missing for cleaner look (cosmetic only).

action_items: Note from iteration 2 still open: Invoices.jsx (GST invoices) row actions still lack a Download-PDF button — backend /api/invoices/{id}/pdf works but the UI does not expose it. Mirror the pattern from Quotations.jsx / SalesOrders.jsx / ProformaInvoices.jsx (all of which now have working data-testid='pdf-{id}' or 'pi-pdf-{id}' buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/proforma.py is clean (~80 lines): uses crud_* helpers, computes totals server-side via _compute_totals, admin-only delete, PDF response with proper Content-Disposition.
core/models.py ProformaInvoice has Literal-typed currency/incoterms/status — Pydantic enforces enum validation at the boundary.
core/utils.next_doc_number uses MongoDB find_one_and_update with upsert+$inc — atomic, race-safe across requests; same counter pattern as PO/QUO/SO/INV.
core/words.amount_in_words handles up to trillion and per-currency major/minor names (Dollars/Cents, Euros/Cents, Pounds/Pence, Dirhams/Fils, Rupees/Paise) — verified in PDF output.

core/pi_pdf.py renders a structured export PI: black header, buyer/logistics two-column block, line-item table with currency-aware money formatter, yellow TOTAL row, amount-in-words, terms, dual signature — pypdf extraction confirms all key strings present.
Frontend ProformaInvoices.jsx (~680 lines) is at the upper end of the recommended file size; could be split into ProformaList + ProformaForm for maintainability, but not blocking.
All MongoDB queries on proforma_invoices project away _id (regression test verified across 7 collections including proforma_invoices).
